interpretation_limits: This is a D-T2 diffusion-relaxation map, not a D-chemical-shift DOSY map.
NS=4: do not describe this acquisition as single-scan, and do not label 27.768 s as the duration of one scan.
The dominant reconstructed D peak lies at the lower grid boundary, 1e-12 m2/s. Treat this as a reconstruction limitation requiring investigation, not a validated component.
The notebook clips negative values and applies a 1% display threshold. Component counts, marginal amplitudes and apparent peak areas are not independently validated.
Saved numerical convergence does not establish chemical assignment, absolute D/T2 accuracy, quantitative gradient calibration or prototype validation.
Notebook modification postdates the supplied PNG; export code and saved outputs are consistent with the image, but exact reproducibility was not rerun.
